main_topics.reason: The user described repeatedly crashing for days after walks or beginner yoga and asked how exercise could be reconciled with that response.
The user discussed overdoing activity on good days, understood the idea of capping activity, and reflected on years of swinging between overdoing it and giving up.
The user opened by feeling stuck between common advice to exercise and their own experience of worsening afterward.
The user asked whether walking or yoga was preferable and responded positively to the possibility of using a community-center pool.
The user asked how long it might take to notice a difference and said they appreciated not having progress oversold.

output.summary: The user described fibromyalgia symptoms flaring for days after walks or beginner yoga and asked how to exercise without another crash. The assistant suggested starting with a very small amount, pacing activity on good days, considering warm-water exercise, and tracking gradual progress; the user said the advice was genuinely useful and appreciated having a practical plan.
